scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/providers && npm run build -w packages/roblox && npm run build -w packages/testkit
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w apps/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/providers && npm run test -w packages/roblox && npm run test -w apps/cli && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/providers && npm run typecheck -w packages/roblox && npm run typecheck -w packages/testkit && npm run typecheck -w apps/cli && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/providers && npm run typecheck -w packages/roblox && npm run typecheck -w apps/cli
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.pack:cli: npm run build:cli && npm pack -w apps/cli
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:bundle && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run test:visual
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web && npm run deploy:health
